easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 7 if your storm counter is zero, at least 5 if your storm counter is one, or at least 4 otherwise.
description:
Cast the artifact with mana value 2 or less by paying {0} and 3 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Blood Funnel trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, countering the artifact spell.
Repeat.
